A [[human]] was a '''[[Dhani]] chieftain''' who<ref name="The Eye" /> in [[5 BBY]]<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' dates the events of "[[The Eye]]" to [[5 BBY]].</ref> led a pilgrimage on the [[planet]] [[Aldhani]] to the sacred temple [[Nasma Brani]] to watch the occurrence of the [[Eye of Aldhani]].<ref name="The Eye" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The character first appeared, albeit unidentified, in "[[The Eye]]", the sixth episode of [[Andor Season 1|the first season]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor|Andor]]'', and was portrayed by actor [[David Hayman]].<ref name="The Eye" />
